entities.name: Cleopatra VII
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Last active ruler of Ptolemaic Egypt (69–30 BCE), renowned for her intelligence, political acumen, and alliances with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony. Her defeat at Actium ended Egyptian independence and the Hellenistic era.
